title: Something Kept Unzipping Our Tent at 3 AM #shorts #horror
description: We camped miles from anyone. At 3 AM, our tent started unzipping by itself. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory #camping

hook.text: Never zip the tent back up.

lines.text: My brother and I camped deep in the woods.
No cell signal. No other campers for miles.
At three in the morning, I heard a zipper.
Our tent door was slowly opening.
I zipped it shut. My brother kept snoring.
A minute later, it started unzipping again.
I whispered his name. He didn't move.
Then I heard his voice. Outside the tent.
Let me in. That isn't me in there.
The thing beside me stopped snoring.
And slowly turned to face me.
